data.title: 凯尔希 · 潮汐沉积岩崖壁前的生理生化采样
data.action: 戴着轻薄防水乳胶手套，半蹲在潮汐带露出的古老沉积岩层旁，用不锈钢镊子小心取样藻类标本，神情肃穆冷静
data.location: 人迹罕至的地质断层海蚀断崖与潮下带浅坑
data.lighting: 清晨冷光扫过叠层岩面，潮沟的反光沿白亚麻下摆抬亮前景
data.mood: 绝对理性、超凡脱俗与历经千百年岁月的医者沉思
data.description: 破晓的海雾还未散去，海水在古老的页岩层下低沉咆哮。凯尔希将及踝的白麻长袍收拢在膝边，冷静地将带有荧光的深海苔藓封入真空采样管。她没有抬头，仅凭足音便准确判定了来者的方位，声音平稳如钟摆——「这处潮间带的沉积物记录了泰拉三次重大的气候骤变。海水的盐度与矿物浓度正在上升，属于地质学上的必然规律。……既然醒得这么早，就拿着冷光灯过来，替我照亮岩缝第三层的生物采样点。」
data.promptProse: At dawn, Kal'tsit squats on a flat shelf beside a tidal pool, her charcoal-gray racing swimsuit zipped high under an open white linen duster. With one gloved hand she steadies a clear sample tube upright. The other raises a thin strand of algae over the tube with stainless tweezers. Frame the two tools and the exposed bands of sediment on the wave-cut cliff together. The coat hem catches reflected light from the shallows, while morning fog gathers where the strata meet the ocean.
data.animaCaption: Squatting beside the rocky tide pool in her fitted gray competition swimsuit and open white linen duster, Kal'tsit uses steel tweezers to lower a dark strand of algae into a clear sample tube. Low dawn mist clings to the layered sea cliff behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a sleek charcoal-gray high-collar zipped competition one-piece swimsuit beneath an open white linen duster gathered near her knees, leaving her slender thighs bare.
